verification.structure: Every id, cluster letter, sub-standard letter set, (+) marker (standards and sub-standards) and modeling star was checked mechanically against the text of CCSSO's official Common Core State Standards for Mathematics PDF: 385/385 ids, 124 sub-standards, 43 (+) standards, 5 (+) sub-standards, 61 modeling standards. That PDF misprints 1.OA.B.3 as 1.0A.B.3.
verification.k8Emphasis: Cluster emphasis (major, supporting, additional) checked by verifier agents against the Student Achievement Partners focus documents.
verification.hsCourse: Typical course follows CCSS Appendix A's traditional pathway, checked by verifier agents.
verification.edges: Direct prerequisite and connection edges authored from the CCSS Progressions and reviewed by one adversarial verifier per grade band; mechanically checked for unknown ids, backward grade direction, cycles and transitive shortcuts (3 transitive prerequisites removed). These are pedagogical judgments, not an official CCSS product.
verification.titles: Short paraphrases; K-8 titles reuse data/ccssStandards.ts from MAIS-MVP.
verification.knownDisagreement: Four cluster-level links in MAIS data/ccssCoherenceMap.ts (4.OA->4.NF, 4.NBT->4.NF, 5.NBT->5.NF, 5.OA->5.G) have no standard-level prerequisite; the verifiers treated those relationships as connections or non-gating.
